intro.text: This is Chandigarh, and it is not really a state at all: it is one city, and that city is the whole place. Somebody drew the whole thing on paper in squares before any of it was built. Every square is called a sector and has a number instead of a name. Punjab and Haryana share it.

animal.text: The grey mongoose is Chandigarh's own animal. Every hair on him has pale rings, so he looks speckled. He fights snakes by dodging, making them strike until they tire out.

food.text: Chandigarh's own fruit is the mango and its own tree is the mango tree. When the rains come the city puts on a mango show, with tables and tables of them, all different.

festival.text: Once a year, in the last week of November, an amusement park goes up in the middle of the city, with stalls and music and shows all day. It is the Chandigarh Carnival.

hello.text: Chandigarh has two official languages, and one of them is English, the same English you are hearing now. So here you can just say Hello and everybody knows what you mean.

line.text: One man made all of this on his own, in secret, out of things people had thrown away: smashed bangles, broken plates, bits of tile. He hid it for eighteen years before anybody found out. There are more than five thousand little figures standing about in rows.

This lake was not here at all until somebody dammed a stream and made it, in 1958. No engines are allowed on the water, not one, so the boats tied up along the edge are the sort you push along with your feet.

A giant metal hand stands on a tower here, twenty-six metres from the ground up to the top of it. The hand alone weighs more than forty tonnes, and the wind still turns it round. It is meant to say: a hand open to give, and open to take.

Fifty thousand rose bushes grow in this garden, of sixteen hundred different kinds. Bed after bed after bed of them, in every colour a rose can be. Once a year the whole city comes and walks up and down and looks at them.

landmarks.name: The Butterfly Park
landmarks.photoQuery: Common Mormon butterfly Butterfly Park Chandigarh

line.text: This butterfly is jet black with a row of white spots across each back wing, and it is nearly as wide as your hand. The females come in more than one pattern, and some are made up to look like a different butterfly altogether, one that birds will not eat.
